meta_patch_data.patch_description: Preserve full conversion on detected change, but inherit the two-particle follow-up only for the next update and only when the preceding update produced no shared-best improvement. The unconditional three-update extension worsened development error; this crossover tests whether one selective retry supports recovery with less disruption to ordinary PSO. Performance improvement remains untested.
